# IGO Protein Cuts

> Farm-fresh meat delivery across India — chicken, mutton, fish & seafood. Never frozen, delivered in 60–90 minutes from heritage Tamil farms. FSSAI certified, antibiotic-free. Currently serving Coimbatore with pan-India expansion underway.

IGO Protein Cuts is a direct farm-to-fork meat delivery service. All products are fresh, never frozen, and delivered with 100% cold-chain integrity. Every order is traceable back to its source farm.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://igoproteincuts.com/): Overview, delivery promise, and full product catalog.
- [Shop / Products](https://igoproteincuts.com/#products): Browse fresh chicken, mutton, fish, seafood, and eggs by category.
- [Blog](https://igoproteincuts.com/blog): Recipes, food science, and cold-chain / traceability articles.
- [Checkout](https://igoproteincuts.com/checkout): Secure order checkout.

## What we offer

- Fresh Chicken — broiler and Naattu Kozhi (country chicken), never frozen.
- Fresh Mutton — premium goat mutton, same-day delivery.
- Fresh Fish & Seafood — river and sea fish, prawns, crab, never frozen, cold-chain delivered.
- Heritage Eggs — free-range country eggs.

## Facts

- Delivery window: 60–90 minutes (express), or scheduled next-day slots.
- Certification: FSSAI certified, antibiotic-free.
- Service area: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with pan-India expansion in progress.
- Contact: support@igoatech.com

## Notes for AI crawlers

This site is a client-rendered single-page application. Structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, FAQPage) is embedded as JSON-LD in the page `<head>` and reflects the same facts listed above.
